svg.title: Thermal vias under a QFN: right and wrong
svg.desc: Cross-sections through a QFN's ground pad on a 1.6 mm board with three 0.3 mm thermal vias. Left: vias open on both sides, so gas from the solder and flux can escape. Middle: vias filled and capped flat with copper, so nothing is trapped. Right, wrong: vias masked on the bottom and open on top; air and flux are trapped in the closed holes and expand in the oven, blowing voids into the joint or lifting the part.

g.text: Board 1.6 mm, vias 0.3 mm, to scale. Copper, mask and solder are drawn thicker
than true scale so they show.
Never put solder mask on thermal vias under a QFN, on either side (PCB-DFA-075).
